Ryan Fazio

Republican / Independent candidate for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Connecticut · Challenger

Connecticut state senator (36th District); financial advisor

Ryan Fazio is a Republican state senator from Greenwich who has represented Connecticut's 36th Senate District since 2021. He announced his campaign for governor in August 2025. Wikipedia cites a CT Insider report that Connecticut Republicans nominated him for governor at their May 2026 convention, after Erin Stewart dropped out of the race.

Where Fazio stands

Affordability / cost of living
Pledges to lower state income taxes, cap local property taxes and reduce electric rates, and calls the high cost of living a central issue of his campaign.
Energy / electric rates
As ranking Senate Republican on the Energy and Technology Committee, helped draft a bipartisan energy bill that moves some costs, including part of the public benefits charge, off ratepayer bills.
State budget / taxes
Supports keeping the state's volatility, bonding and revenue caps, with the aim of limiting tax increases and state debt.
Abortion
Has said he favors keeping abortion legal in Connecticut. In 2022 he voted against HB 5414, which let midwives and nurses perform aspiration abortions without a doctor.

Background

  • Connecticut State Senate, 36th District, 2021–present (special election 2021; re-elected 2022 and 2024)
  • Ranking Senate Republican, Energy and Technology Committee
  • Career in the commodities industry (renewable fuels, agriculture); currently a financial advisor
  • B.A. in Economics, Northwestern University, 2012
  • Born March 27, 1990, in Norwalk, Connecticut

Also running for Governor and Lieutenant Governor

  • Ned Lamont Democratic / Working Families
